definitions.gloss: rapidly; quickly; at a fast pace
definitions.explanation: Describes something happening or changing at a noticeably fast rate. Often used in news and academic writing about trends and developments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急速|きゅうそく}に⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{急速|きゅうそく}に⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{少子化|しょうしか}→少子化：04807_shoushika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急速|きゅうそく}に⟦{減少|げんしょう}している→減少する：19026_genshousuru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the declining birthrate, the population in rural areas is decreasing rapidly.

notes: Commonly appears in news articles and formal writing about societal changes, economic trends, and technological developments. Common collocations include {急速|きゅうそく}に⟦{発展|はってん}する→発展する：25331_hattensuru⟧ (to develop rapidly), {急速|きゅうそく}に⟦{広|ひろ}まる→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧ (to spread rapidly), and {急速|きゅうそく}に⟦{変化|へんか}する→変化する：20997_henkasuru⟧ (to change rapidly). The base form ⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧ can also function as a な-adjective: {急速|きゅうそく}な⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧ (rapid change).
